notice: Fictional Marrow and Co. records. They are not a customer and they are not the demo workspace.

documents.text: Marrow and Co. cold storage is 18 pounds per pallet per week. The minimum term is 4 weeks. The rate code is MARROW-COLD-18.
The Marrow bonded yard at 18 Quay Lane, Bristol holds 42 pallets. The yard code is MARROW-YARD-42.
Marrow answers storage questions within 4 business hours. Cargo claims must be filed within 14 days.
Marrow cargo cover pays up to 250000 pounds. Cover excludes perishable spoilage and delay.
A new Marrow account needs a signed schedule and a deposit of 500 pounds before the first inbound pallet.
The staff pantry menu lists soup, bread, and tea. It does not describe freight.
The office closet holds paper, spare chairs, and printer toner.
